literature.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 确定了 15 例疑似 猴痘 入院病例,占 330 例隔离病房入院病例的 4.5%(95% 置信区间 2.8-7.4)。2022 年入院人数集中(15 人中的 9 人;60.0%),其中 6 人于 2022 年 7 月入院,其中可能包括来自同一地区的 4 名 7-14 岁儿童和青少年,他们彼此在 8 天内就诊。记录了 3 例死亡(病死率 20.0%,95% 置信区间 7.0-45.2),其中包括 1 例并发急性呼吸窘迫综合征的播散性病例。 [10.64898/2026.08.25.26360975]
TK 缺陷型 MPXV 突变体在细胞培养中复制到与野生型病毒相似的滴度,但在体内减弱,如 CAST/EiJ 小鼠皮内感染模型所示。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2717859]
典型病例通常包括发烧、淋巴结肿大和离心性水疱脓疱性皮疹。然而,最近的 暴发 揭示了非典型表现,包括生殖器和肛周病变、轻微或不存在前驱症状以及异步皮疹 进化。 [10.24171/j.phrp.2025.0402]
研究观察到,猴痘 被确定为一种罕见的性传播皮肤病,患者 队列研究 具有特定的临床特征。 [10.20452/jmr.2026.20060]

参与者的平均年龄为 38.8 ± 7.4 岁,其中男性占多数(60.7%)。只有 18.9% 的人有诊断或处理 猴痘 的经验,5.8% 的人对 猴痘 有良好的了解,平均总体知识得分为 61.7 ± 12.5%。具有≥10年实践经验(p=0.049)、高级专业干部(p=0.031)以及诊断或处理猴痘经验(p=0.021)的参与者与较高的平均知识得分相关。 [10.1186/s12913-026-15473-3]

The TK-deficient MPXV mutant replicated to similar titers as the wild-type virus in cell culture but was attenuated in vivo, as shown in the CAST/EiJ mouse intradermal infection model. [10.1080/22221751.2026.2717859]

Classical cases typically involve fever, lymphadenopathy, and a centrifugal vesiculopustular rash; however, recent outbreaks have revealed atypical presentations, including genital and perianal lesions, minimal or absent prodromal symptoms, and asynchronous rash evolution. [10.24171/j.phrp.2025.0402]
The study observed that mpox was identified as a rare sexually transmitted dermatosis, with specific clinical features noted in the patient cohort. [10.20452/jmr.2026.20060]

Between Oct 28, 2024, and June 30, 2025, 310 participants were enrolled (median age 14·0 years [IQR 2·5-25·0]; 166 [54%] female). At enrolment, conjunctival disease was present in 112 (36% [95% CI 31-42]) participants, corneal disease in 24 (8% [5-11]), and anterior uveitis in two (1% [0-2]). [10.1016/j.langlo.2026.104054]

news.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 猴痘 暴发 在全球范围内持续存在,自 2022 年以来,分支 IIb 是导致 暴发 的主要类型。分支 I 猴痘 暴发 在美国和其他地区已有报道,病例与旅行或性接触有关。CDC 报告称,这些 暴发 正在受到监控和管理。 [news-fdc3204da7442fc6]
I型猴痘病毒(clade I monkeypox)病例自2023年底起在中非和东非地区持续报告,西欧国家的新发病例可能与持续流行相关。CDC确认,美国I型猴痘病例数自2026年3月起上升,截至2026年7月,报告病例超过50例。这些病例主要与旅行史或与感染者接触相关。 [news-b376fd2a7f832a03]
澳门卫生局报告一宗输入性猴痘确诊病例;患者住院并接受 治疗 治疗;根据旅行和接触史,病例被归类为输入病例。 [news-0ce2a3a8508b444f]
几内亚比绍出现了新的 暴发 病例,这是该国首例病例。2022 年全球 暴发 被宣布为公共卫生紧急状态,随后于 2023 年 5 月解除。2024 年 暴发 也被宣布为公共卫生紧急状态,并于 2025 年 9 月解除。 [news-72279b990b562636]
台湾疾病预防控制中心报告了两例涉及 Ib 分支菌株的 猴痘 国内新病例,这是该变种的首例国内病例。医生根据症状怀疑猴痘后,通过医学检测确认了这些病例。 [news-eef3c5835878d7a6]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Mpox virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Monkeypox outbreaks are ongoing globally, with clade IIb being the primary type causing the outbreak since 2022. Clade I monkeypox outbreaks have been reported in the United States and other regions, with cases linked to travel or sexual contact. The CDC reports that these outbreaks are being monitored and managed. [news-fdc3204da7442fc6]

Outbreaks of clade I monkeypox have been reported in Central and Eastern Africa since late 2023, with newer outbreaks in Western European countries likely related to the ongoing outbreak. [news-b376fd2a7f832a03]

Macao Health Bureau reported one confirmed imported mpox (monkeypox) case; patient is hospitalized and receiving treatment; case classified as imported based on travel and exposure history. [news-0ce2a3a8508b444f]

A fresh outbreak of mpox in Guinea Bissau, marking the country’s first case, has occurred. The 2022 global outbreak was declared a public health emergency and later lifted in May 2023. The 2024 outbreak was also declared a public health emergency and lifted in September 2025. [news-72279b990b562636]

Taiwan's CDC reported two new domestic cases of Mpox involving the clade Ib strain, marking the first domestic cases of this variant. The cases were confirmed through medical testing after doctors suspected Mpox based on symptoms. [news-eef3c5835878d7a6]

papers.title: Mpox Airborne Transmission: A Systematic Review.
papers.abstract: Since May 2022, mpox has been reported across multiple nonendemic regions, with concurrent outbreaks in diverse geographic settings, raising concerns about broader international spread. However, evidence regarding the risk of airborne transmission remains limited. We conducted a systematic review to evaluate the risk of airborne transmission and the presence of viable viruses in air samples. PubMed, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies published in English, including environmental studies, case reports, cross-sectional studies, and cohort studies. Data extraction included study characteristics (authors, year, design, and setting), sample size, diagnostic methods, participant characteristics, follow-up, type of respiratory particles assessed (droplets and/or aerosols), and key findings. Of 286 records identified, four studies met the inclusion criteria. All were environmental studies published between 2022 and 2023. MPXV DNA was detected in surface and air samples, with cycle threshold (Ct) values ranging from < 30 to < 45. However, none of the studies demonstrated consistent viral viability in aerosols or droplets sufficient to support airborne transmission. Overall, the available evidence is limited and does not support a clear risk of airborne infection. Further well-designed studies in human settings are needed to clarify the potential for mpox transmission through respiratory routes. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: PROSPERO: CRD42023391123.

papers.title: Emerging infectious diseases (Mpox, Nipah, and Andes): A narrative review of transmission, environmental survival, and disinfection
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus are emerging infectious diseases that cause outbreaks associated with nosocomial transmission. METHODS: This narrative review summarizes the Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus epidemiology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment with a focus on environmental survival, susceptibility to antiseptics and disinfectants, and infection prevention. RESULTS: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus all survive in the environment and are capable of indirect transmission. All these viruses are enveloped and susceptible to commonly used antiseptics and surface disinfectants. CONCLUSIONS: Rapid identification of patients with known or suspected infections of these emerging viruses coupled with adherence to infection prevention recommendations will prevent healthcare-associated transmission.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus are emerging infectious diseases that cause outbreaks associated with nosocomial transmission. METHODS: This narrative review summarizes the Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus epidemiology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment with a focus on environmental survival, susceptibility to antiseptics and disinfectants, and infection prevention. RESULTS: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus all survive in the environment and are capable of indirect transmission. All these viruses are enveloped and susceptible to commonly used antiseptics and surface disinfectants. CONCLUSIONS: Rapid identification of patients with known or suspected infections of these emerging viruses coupled with adherence to infection prevention recommendations will prevent healthcare-associated transmission.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘、尼帕病毒和安第斯病毒是新出现的传染病,导致与医院 传播 相关的 暴发。方法:这篇叙述性综述总结了 猴痘、尼帕病毒和安第斯病毒 流行病学、临床表现、诊断 和 治疗,重点是环境生存、对防腐剂和消毒剂的敏感性以及感染预防。结果:猴痘、尼帕病毒和安第斯病毒都可以在环境中生存,并且能够间接感染 传播。所有这些病毒都有包膜,对常用的防腐剂和表面消毒剂敏感。结论:快速识别已知或疑似感染这些新出现病毒的患者,并遵守感染预防建议,将预防与医疗保健相关的 传播。

papers.title: Molecular cloning of a monkeypox virus clade IIb genome and construction of an attenuated mutant for basic and translational research
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is a rodent-borne orthopoxvirus causing mpox disease upon zoonotic transmission to humans. Recent global outbreaks have raised awareness and highlighted the need for basic and translational research. However, research is hampered by the classification of MPXV as a Risk Group 3 pathogen. In an effort to overcome this limitation, we generated a complete full-length MPXV clade IIb bacterial artificial chromosome (BAC) clone by single-step transformation-associated recombination (STAR) cloning in yeast. The integrity of the cloned MPXV genome sequence and the replication capability of the BAC-derived virus were verified. To obtain an attenuated mutant, the viral thymidine kinase (TK) gene, OPG101, was deleted by BAC recombineering. The TK-deficient MPXV mutant replicated to similar titers as the wild-type virus in cell culture but was attenuated in vivo, as shown in the CAST/EiJ mouse intradermal infection model. The attenuated TK-deficient MPXV mutant has the potential to be classified as a Risk Group 2 pathogen by regulatory authorities. This would allow research to be conducted in Biosafety Level 2 laboratories and greatly facilitate basic and applied MPXV research. For example, we demonstrate that the TK-deficient virus can be used for the detection of neutralizing antibodies in human serum samples or for antiviral drug testing.

papers.title_zh: 猴痘病毒分支IIb 基因组的分子克隆及减毒突变株构建用于基础与转化研究
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is a rodent-borne orthopoxvirus causing mpox disease upon zoonotic transmission to humans. Recent global outbreaks have raised awareness and highlighted the need for basic and translational research. However, research is hampered by the classification of MPXV as a Risk Group 3 pathogen. In an effort to overcome this limitation, we generated a complete full-length MPXV clade IIb bacterial artificial chromosome (BAC) clone by single-step transformation-associated recombination (STAR) cloning in yeast. The integrity of the cloned MPXV genome sequence and the replication capability of the BAC-derived virus were verified. To obtain an attenuated mutant, the viral thymidine kinase (TK) gene, OPG101, was deleted by BAC recombineering. The TK-deficient MPXV mutant replicated to similar titers as the wild-type virus in cell culture but was attenuated in vivo, as shown in the CAST/EiJ mouse intradermal infection model. The attenuated TK-deficient MPXV mutant has the potential to be classified as a Risk Group 2 pathogen by regulatory authorities. This would allow research to be conducted in Biosafety Level 2 laboratories and greatly facilitate basic and applied MPXV research. For example, we demonstrate that the TK-deficient virus can be used for the detection of neutralizing antibodies in human serum samples or for antiviral drug testing.

papers.title: Toward Precision Vaccinology for Mpox: Rational Antigen Design, Next-Generation Platforms, and Immune Correlates of Protection
papers.abstract: Mpox has emerged as a global public health concern, highlighting the limitations of traditional vaccinia-based vaccination strategies and the urgent need for precision vaccinology approaches. Advances in structural virology and immunoinformatics have enabled the identification of conserved immunodominant antigens from both mature virion and extracellular virion forms, supporting the development of multivalent antigen combinations capable of inducing broad neutralizing antibody (nAb) responses. Emerging delivery technologies including mRNA-lipid nanoparticles, viral vectors, and self-assembling protein nanoparticles offer rapid scalability, enhanced immunogenicity, and improved safety compared with conventional live-attenuated vaccines. Addressing antigenic evolution, vaccine supply limitations, and population-specific immune variability will be crucial for optimizing vaccine effectiveness. This review synthesizes current evidence on antigen design, vaccine delivery platforms, and immunological correlates of protection to outline a framework for next-generation mpox vaccines. Precision vaccinology therefore represents a transformative strategy for developing durable, clade-specific mpox vaccines and strengthening preparedness against future orthopoxvirus outbreaks worldwide.

papers.title_zh: 面向精准疫苗学的猴痘:理性抗原设计、下一代平台与保护性免疫相关因子
papers.source_body_en: Mpox has emerged as a global public health concern, highlighting the limitations of traditional vaccinia-based vaccination strategies and the urgent need for precision vaccinology approaches. Advances in structural virology and immunoinformatics have enabled the identification of conserved immunodominant antigens from both mature virion and extracellular virion forms, supporting the development of multivalent antigen combinations capable of inducing broad neutralizing antibody (nAb) responses. Emerging delivery technologies including mRNA-lipid nanoparticles, viral vectors, and self-assembling protein nanoparticles offer rapid scalability, enhanced immunogenicity, and improved safety compared with conventional live-attenuated vaccines. Addressing antigenic evolution, vaccine supply limitations, and population-specific immune variability will be crucial for optimizing vaccine effectiveness. This review synthesizes current evidence on antigen design, vaccine delivery platforms, and immunological correlates of protection to outline a framework for next-generation mpox vaccines. Precision vaccinology therefore represents a transformative strategy for developing durable, clade-specific mpox vaccines and strengthening preparedness against future orthopoxvirus outbreaks worldwide.
papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘已成为全球公共卫生关切,凸显了基于天花疫苗的传统疫苗接种策略的局限性,并迫切需要精准疫苗学方法。结构病毒学与免疫信息学的进展已使从成熟病毒体与细胞外病毒体两种形式中识别保守免疫优势抗原成为可能,从而支持开发可诱导广谱中和抗体(nAb)应答的多价抗原组合。新兴递送技术包括mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒、病毒媒介与自组装蛋白纳米颗粒,在快速可扩展性、增强免疫原性与改善安全性方面优于传统减毒活疫苗。解决抗原性进化、疫苗供应限制及人群特异性免疫变异性将是优化疫苗效果的关键。本综述整合了当前关于抗原设计、疫苗递送平台与免疫保护相关因子的证据,以勾勒下一代猴痘 疫苗的框架。因此,精准疫苗学代表了一种变革性策略,用于开发持久的、分支特异性猴痘 疫苗,并加强全球应对未来正痘病毒 暴发的能力。

papers.title: Association of Social Determinants of Health, Age, Sex and Sexual Exposure with HIV, Acquired Syphilis, and Mpox Detection Rates in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: An Ecological Study
papers.abstract: Abstract This study employs a neighborhood-level Social Protection Index (SPI) to analyze how socioeconomic factors relate to the detection of HIV, acquired syphilis, and mpox. We conducted a retrospective analysis of 2022 surveillance data from Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, using case notifications geolocated to neighborhoods. Population data were obtained from the 2022 census. Neighborhoods were stratified by SPI into quintiles, and detection rates per 100,000 population were calculated by sexual exposure category. Associations between age, SPI, and detection rates were analyzed using multilevel Poisson regression models with random intercepts, fitted separately for men who gave sex with men (MSM), heterosexual men and women. Of 2,876 new HIV cases, the highest detection rate was among MSM (1,522/100,000). Of 13,676 syphilis cases, the male-to-female detection ratio was 1.7:1. Of 957 mpox cases, 80% occurred among MSM (812/100,000). HIV and syphilis clustered in lower SPI neighborhoods, while mpox concentrated in higher SPI neighborhoods. For HIV, younger age showed the strongest association among MSM, while lower SPI was strongest among women. For syphilis, younger age was most important among women, with strong SPI associations in both sexes. Among MSM, mpox was concentrated in 25-39 age group and higher SPI neighborhoods. Strong socioeconomic gradients among women reflect intersecting gender and socioeconomic inequalities. Among MSM, attenuated socioeconomic gradients and distinct mpox patterns suggest social and sexual networks shape transmission alongside structural factors. Prevention must address social determinants and network structures.

papers.title: Suspected mpox admissions to a dedicated infectious-diseases isolation ward in northeastern Nigeria, 2022–2025: a register-based descriptive study with evidence of a household cluster
papers.abstract: Mpox has re-emerged as a public-health priority across Nigeria, and successive international public-health emergencies were declared in 2022 and 2024. Facility-level descriptions of admitted, clinically suspected cases from northeastern Nigeria remain sparse. We conducted a register-based descriptive study of all admissions to the infectious-diseases isolation ward of Modibbo Adama University Teaching Hospital, Yola, in which mpox was recorded as the working or a differential diagnosis between February 2022 and January 2025. Age, sex, month of admission, locality, recorded clinical impression, and outcome were abstracted and summarised, with proportions reported using Wilson 95% confidence intervals. Fifteen suspected mpox admissions were identified, representing 4.5% (95% confidence interval 2.8-7.4) of 330 isolation-ward admissions. The median age was 20 years (interquartile range 13-37; range 7-57); six patients (40.0%) were children under 18 years and 12 (80.0%) were male, giving a male-to-female ratio of 4:1. Admissions clustered in 2022 (9 of 15; 60.0%), with six in July 2022, including a probable household cluster of four children and adolescents aged 7-14 years from a single locality who presented within eight days of one another. Three deaths were recorded (case fatality 20.0%, 95% confidence interval 7.0-45.2), including one disseminated case complicated by acute respiratory distress syndrome. The demographic profile closely matches previously reported Adamawa State and national surveillance data, whereas the elevated case fatality reflects referral concentration and diagnostic uncertainty rather than true mpox-attributable mortality. Cases were clinically suspected rather than laboratory-confirmed, which is the principal limitation of this study. We recommend targeted strengthening of laboratory diagnosis at facility and sub-national level, including dual monkeypox-varicella testing algorithms, use of existing molecular platforms rather than new infrastructure, and mandatory recording of laboratory results within ward registers.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes suspected mpox admissions to an infectious-diseases isolation ward in northeastern Nigeria from February 2022 to January 2025. It identifies 15 suspected cases, representing 4.5% of total admissions, with a notable cluster in July 2022 involving four children from the same locality. Three deaths were recorded, with a case fatality rate of 20.0%. The findings suggest that the elevated case fatality rate may be due to diagnostic uncertainty and referral patterns rather than the disease itself. The study highlights the need for improved laboratory diagnosis and reporting. However, the reliance on clinical suspicion rather than laboratory confirmation is a key limitation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘 已重新成为尼日利亚各地的公共卫生优先事项,并于 2022 年和 2024 年连续宣布国际公共卫生紧急情况。来自尼日利亚东北部的收治临床疑似病例的设施级别描述仍然很少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对约拉莫迪博阿达玛大学教学医院传染病隔离病房的所有入院患者进行了一项基于登记的描述性研究,其中 猴痘 被记录为 2022 年 2 月至 2025 年 1 月期间的工作或差异 诊断。
elements_zh.methods: 对年龄、性别、入院月份、地点、记录的临床印象和结果进行了抽象和总结,并使用威尔逊 95% 置信区间报告了比例。
elements_zh.main_results: 确定了 15 例疑似 猴痘 入院病例,占 330 例隔离病房入院病例的 4.5%(95% 置信区间 2.8-7.4)。2022 年入院人数集中(15 人中的 9 人;60.0%),其中 6 人于 2022 年 7 月入院,其中可能包括来自同一地区的 4 名 7-14 岁儿童和青少年,他们彼此在 8 天内就诊。记录了 3 例死亡(病死率 20.0%,95% 置信区间 7.0-45.2),其中包括 1 例并发急性呼吸窘迫综合征的播散性病例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 人口统计资料与先前报告的阿达马瓦州和国家 监测 数据非常匹配,而病例死亡率升高反映了转诊集中度和诊断不确定性,而不是真正的 猴痘 归因的 死亡率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们建议有针对性地加强设施和地方层面的实验室 诊断,包括双重猴痘-水痘检测算法、使用现有分子平台而不是新基础设施,以及在病房登记册中强制记录实验室结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 病例是临床怀疑的而非实验室确诊的,这是本研究的主要局限性。

Fifteen suspected mpox admissions were identified, representing 4.5% (95% confidence interval 2.8-7.4) of 330 isolation-ward admissions. The median age was 20 years (interquartile range 13-37; range 7-57); six patients (40.0%) were children under 18 years and 12 (80.0%) were male, giving a male-to-female ratio of 4:1. Admissions clustered in 2022 (9 of 15; 60.0%), with six in July 2022, including a probable household cluster of four children and adolescents aged 7-14 years from a single locality who presented within eight days of one another. Three deaths were recorded (case fatality 20.0%, 95% confidence interval 7.0-45.2), including one disseminated case complicated by acute respiratory distress syndrome. The demographic profile closely matches previously reported Adamawa State and national surveillance data, whereas the elevated case fatality reflects referral concentration and diagnostic uncertainty rather than true mpox-attributable mortality. Cases were clinically suspected rather than laboratory-confirmed, which is the principal limitation of this study. We recommend targeted strengthening of laboratory diagnosis at facility and sub-national level, including dual monkeypox-varicella testing algorithms, use of existing molecular platforms rather than new infrastructure, and mandatory recording of laboratory results within ward registers.

papers.title: Prevalence, characteristics, and clinical course of mpox-related ophthalmic disease (MBOTE-EYE): a prospective cohort study in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Systematic longitudinal ophthalmologist-led assessment of mpox-related ophthalmic disease (MPOXROD) is rarely reported. We aimed to characterise the prevalence and clinical course of MPOXROD under supportive management during a clade Ib outbreak. METHODS: MBOTE-EYE was a substudy nested within a prospective cohort in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. All hospitalised patients with PCR-confirmed mpox (within the last 48 h) were eligible. Participants underwent ophthalmological examination at enrolment, discharge, and days 29 and 59. Conjunctival swabs were collected for monkeypox virus PCR. Risk factors for MPOXROD were assessed using mixed-effects Poisson regression. FINDINGS: Between Oct 28, 2024, and June 30, 2025, 310 participants were enrolled (median age 14·0 years [IQR 2·5-25·0]; 166 [54%] female). At enrolment, conjunctival disease was present in 112 (36% [95% CI 31-42]) participants, corneal disease in 24 (8% [5-11]), and anterior uveitis in two (1% [0-2]). Overall, 134 (43% [38-49]) participants developed MPOXROD during follow-up, most often bilaterally. Blindness following ulcerative keratitis occurred in two (1% [0-3]) of 224 participants. Periorbital lesions (adjusted risk ratio [aRR] 3·65 [95% CI 2·42-5·49]) and severe acute malnutrition (aRR 3·16 [1·22-8·22]) were associated with MPOXROD. PCR was done among 89 patients and cycle threshold values below 25 occurred exclusively during active MPOXROD. INTERPRETATION: Ophthalmic involvement in clade Ib mpox is common and frequently bilateral, with a substantial burden of keratitis and risk of vision loss. Systematic eye examinations should be integrated into mpox care, and targeted ophthalmic therapies should be developed. FUNDING: Canadian Institutes of Health Research and the International Development Research Centre, the European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership, and the Belgian Directorate-General for Development Cooperation and Humanitarian Aid.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: MBOTE-EYE是一项嵌套于刚果民主共和国南基伍省前瞻性队列研究中的子研究。所有在过去48小时内经PCR确诊为猴痘病毒感染的住院患者均符合入组条件。参与者在入组、出院及第29天和第59天接受眼科检查。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究,嵌套在一项更大的研究中,这可能会限制普遍性。证据充分,基于详细的方法和清晰的结果报告进行了高置信度评估。

papers.title: Machine learning-assisted design of a dendritic cell nanovaccine inducing twin immunity against monkeypox.
papers.abstract: The global emergence of monkeypox virus (MPXV) has created an urgent need for effective vaccines that induce robust immune responses. Here, we report a biomimetic nano-vaccine platform based on engineered dendritic cell membrane vesicles displaying M1R (M1R-CMVs), designed via genetic engineering with machine learning-assisted preliminary screening of physicochemical parameters including particle size (~190 nm) and zeta potential (-18 mV). Subcutaneous delivery of M1R-CMVs with CpG adjuvant induced high titers of M1R-specific IgG and potent neutralizing antibodies. The vaccine promoted broad T cell activation, characterized by enhanced CD4 + and CD8 + T cell responses in spleen and lymph nodes, and established durable T cell memory. In vitro studies demonstrated that M1R-CMVs enhance dendritic cell maturation and T cell proliferation. Prime-boost immunization further amplified both humoral and cellular immunity, with significant increases in neutralizing antibody titers and effector T cell populations. Furthermore, the vaccine exhibited a favorable safety profile in vivo with no significant toxicity observed. Our findings demonstrate a biomimetic vaccine design strategy integrating engineered vesicles with machine learning-assisted physicochemical analysis, providing a promising approach to combat monkeypox.

papers.title: SYSTEMATIC REVIEW OF MPOX SEROPREVALENCE IN NIGERIA: EPIDEMIOLOGY, DEMOGRAPHICS, RISK FACTORS, AND CONTROL
papers.abstract: Mpox is a re-emerging zoonotic disease caused by a double-stranded DNA virus of the genus Orthopoxvirus. Since 2017, Nigeria has witnessed a resurgence of Mpox, with outbreaks of increasing magnitude. This study analyzed surveillance data from the Surveillance Outbreak Response and Management System (SORMAS) spanning September 2017 to February 2025, to describe the epidemiology of Mpox and assess implications for surveillance and response. A total of 5,979 suspected cases were reported, of which 1,303 (21.8%) were laboratory-confirmed. Males accounted for 63% of suspected and 65.9% of confirmed cases, while females comprised 37% and 34.1% respectively. The largely affected age group was 20–29 years (47.7% of confirmed cases), reflecting vulnerability among post-smallpox vaccination cohorts. Children under 15 years represented 16% of confirmed cases. Temporal trends revealed outbreak peaks in 2017, 2022, and 2024, suggesting repeated waves and ongoing endemic transmission. Five states (Sokoto, Akwa Ibom, Lagos, Ogun, and Ondo) contributed ~60% of cases, indicating geographic clustering. The overall case fatality rate (CFR) was 7.8%, with slightly higher mortality among females (8.1%) and children (8.2%). Risk factor analysis highlighted both occupational exposure (business/traders, students, farmers) and household clustering (housewives, infants). However, only 9.6% of suspected and 5% of confirmed cases reported contact with an infectious source, underscoring weak case investigation. Surveillance through SORMAS improved data capture and timeliness but was limited by underreporting, incomplete exposure data, and diagnostic bottlenecks. Findings emphasize the need for enhanced One Health surveillance, decentralized diagnostics, community-driven reporting, and targeted risk communication. This study concludes that Mpox in Nigeria has transitioned from sporadic spillover to sustained endemic transmission. Strengthening surveillance and response systems is critical to reducing morbidity, mortality, and the risk of further international spread.

source_records.abstract: Mpox is a re-emerging zoonotic disease caused by a double-stranded DNA virus of the genus Orthopoxvirus. Since 2017, Nigeria has witnessed a resurgence of Mpox, with outbreaks of increasing magnitude. This study analyzed surveillance data from the Surveillance Outbreak Response and Management System (SORMAS) spanning September 2017 to February 2025, to describe the epidemiology of Mpox and assess implications for surveillance and response. A total of 5,979 suspected cases were reported, of which 1,303 (21.8%) were laboratory-confirmed. Males accounted for 63% of suspected and 65.9% of confirmed cases, while females comprised 37% and 34.1% respectively. The largely affected age group was 20–29 years (47.7% of confirmed cases), reflecting vulnerability among post-smallpox vaccination cohorts. Children under 15 years represented 16% of confirmed cases. Temporal trends revealed outbreak peaks in 2017, 2022, and 2024, suggesting repeated waves and ongoing endemic transmission. Five states (Sokoto, Akwa Ibom, Lagos, Ogun, and Ondo) contributed ~60% of cases, indicating geographic clustering. The overall case fatality rate (CFR) was 7.8%, with slightly higher mortality among females (8.1%) and children (8.2%). Risk factor analysis highlighted both occupational exposure (business/traders, students, farmers) and household clustering (housewives, infants). However, only 9.6% of suspected and 5% of confirmed cases reported contact with an infectious source, underscoring weak case investigation. Surveillance through SORMAS improved data capture and timeliness but was limited by underreporting, incomplete exposure data, and diagnostic bottlenecks. Findings emphasize the need for enhanced One Health surveillance, decentralized diagnostics, community-driven reporting, and targeted risk communication. This study concludes that Mpox in Nigeria has transitioned from sporadic spillover to sustained endemic transmission. Strengthening surveillance and response systems is critical to reducing morbidity, mortality, and the risk of further international spread.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines Mpox seroprevalence in Nigeria, focusing on its epidemiology, demographics, risk factors, and control measures. The study analyzed data from the Surveillance Outbreak Response and Management System (SORMAS) between September 2017 and February 2025, revealing 5,979 suspected cases with 1,303 (21.8%) confirmed. Males accounted for 63% of suspected and 65.9% of confirmed cases, while the 20–29 years age group was most affected (47.7%). The overall case fatality rate was 7.8%, with higher mortality among females and children. Risk factors included occupational exposure and household clustering, though only 9.6% of suspected and 5% of confirmed cases reported contact with an infectious source. The study highlights the need for improved surveillance, diagnostics, and risk communication, as well as the geographic clustering of cases in five states. It concludes that Mpox in Nigeria has transitioned from sporadic spillover to sustained endemic transmission, emphasizing the importance of strengthening systems to mitigate further spread and impact.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 猴痘 是一种重新出现的人畜共患疾病,由 正痘病毒 属的双链 DNA 病毒引起。自2017年以来,尼日利亚出现了“猴痘”的死灰复燃,且“暴发”的规模不断加大。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本研究分析了 监测 暴发 响应和管理系统 (SORMAS) 2017 年 9 月至 2025 年 2 月的 监测 数据,以描述 猴痘 的 流行病学 并评估对 监测 和响应的影响。监测 通过 SORMAS 改进了数据捕获和及时性,但受到报告不足、暴露数据不完整和诊断瓶颈的限制。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 共报告疑似病例5,979例,其中实验室确诊病例1,303例(21.8%)。受影响最大的年龄组是 20-29 岁(确诊病例的 47.7%),反映了天花后 疫苗接种 队列研究 的脆弱性。总体病死率 (CFR) 为 7.8%,其中女性 (8.1%) 和儿童 (8.2%) 的 死亡率 略高。调查结果强调需要增强 One Health 监测、分散诊断、社区驱动的报告和有针对性的风险沟通。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 只有 9.6% 的疑似病例和 5% 的确诊病例报告称与传染源有过接触,这凸显了病例调查的薄弱。风险因素分析强调了职业暴露(商业/贸易商、学生、农民)和家庭聚集(家庭主妇、婴儿)。时间趋势显示 暴发 在 2017 年、2022 年和 2024 年达到峰值,表明 暴发 存在重复波和持续流行。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 加强 监测 和应对系统对于降低发病率、死亡率 以及进一步国际传播的风险至关重要。15岁以下儿童占确诊病例的16%。五个州(索科托、阿夸伊博姆、拉各斯、奥贡和翁多)贡献了约 60% 的病例,表明地理聚集。

papers.title: Rethinking mpox: epidemiology, clinical variants, diagnosis, and response
papers.abstract: Monkeypox disease, now commonly referred to as mpox, was once considered a geographically restricted zoonotic disease but has emerged as a global public health concern. The 2022 multinational outbreak marked a turning point, with notable shifts in transmission dynamics, affected populations, and clinical manifestations. Classical cases typically involve fever, lymphadenopathy, and a centrifugal vesiculopustular rash; however, recent outbreaks have revealed atypical presentations, including genital and perianal lesions, minimal or absent prodromal symptoms, and asynchronous rash evolution. These variations have complicated early clinical recognition and may contribute to delayed diagnosis and onward transmission. This review synthesizes current evidence on the evolving epidemiology of mpox, highlights differences between endemic and non-endemic outbreaks, and describes the full spectrum of typical and atypical clinical features. It also assesses diagnostic approaches, including molecular and point-of-care techniques, and evaluates the efficacy and limitations of current and emerging vaccines, such as JYNNEOS and ACAM2000. Future priorities include improving global surveillance, refining case definitions, expanding diagnostic access, and ensuring equitable vaccine distribution. Understanding the expanding clinical and epidemiological profile of mpox is essential for timely diagnosis, containment, and preparedness against future outbreaks.

papers.title: Examining knowledge of Mpox among primary care physicians in North-Western Nigeria: an online cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Mpox is a rare but re-emerging zoonotic disease that causes significant morbidity and mortality. As primary care physicians serve as gatekeepers in the healthcare system, it is essential that they be proficient at identifying and coordinating care for suspected Mpox patients. However, there is a scarcity of studies on the knowledge of Mpox among primary care doctors in the northwestern geopolitical zone of Nigeria. Objectives This study assessed the knowledge of Mpox and its associated sociodemographic factors among primary care physicians in northwestern Nigeria. Methods This cross-sectional online study employed a multi-stage sampling technique to survey primary care physicians working in Family Medicine/General Outpatient and Pediatric Outpatient Clinics across hospitals in the seven states of North-Western Nigeria. The minimum sample size of 153 was calculated using an assumed 50% prevalence of good Mpox knowledge, a 5% margin of error, and a 95% confidence level; this was increased to 170 after adding a 10% non-response buffer. A total of 155 physicians completed the survey, giving a completion rate of 91.2%. Data were collected using a pretested, online questionnaire, and descriptive and inferential statistical analyses were done using Epi Info (version 7). Results The mean age of participants was 38.8 ± 7.4 years, with male preponderance (60.7%). Most were general outpatient clinic doctors (77.4%), with ≥ 10 years of practice experience (63.2%), and senior registrars (36.1%). Only 18.9% had prior experience in diagnosing or managing Mpox. Nine (5.8%) had good knowledge of Mpox, with a mean overall knowledge score of 61.7 ± 12.5%. Participants with ≥ 10 years of practice experience ( p = 0.049), senior professional cadres ( p = 0.031), and involvement in diagnosing or managing Mpox ( p = 0.021) were associated with higher mean knowledge scores. Conclusions The overall good knowledge rate was notably low, indicating a significant gap in participants’ knowledge of the various aspects of the disease. Senior professional cadres, long years of practice, and experience in the diagnosis and management of Mpox were associated with higher yet suboptimal knowledge scores. Hence, targeted educational interventions are needed to enhance their preparedness to identify and coordinate Mpox cases in primary care settings.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Mpox is a re-emerging zoonotic disease with significant morbidity and mortality, and primary care physicians are critical gatekeepers for identifying and managing suspected cases. There was a scarcity of studies assessing Mpox knowledge among primary care doctors in North-Western Nigeria, creating a knowledge gap that this study aimed to address.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a cross-sectional online study conducted among primary care physicians working in Family Medicine/General Outpatient and Pediatric Outpatient Clinics across hospitals in the seven states of North-Western Nigeria. A total of 155 physicians completed the survey, representing a 91.2% completion rate.
analysis.methods: Data were collected using a pretested, online questionnaire, and descriptive and inferential statistical analyses were performed using Epi Info (version 7). A multi-stage sampling technique was employed, and the minimum sample size of 153 was calculated using an assumed 50% prevalence of good Mpox knowledge, a 5% margin of error, and a 95% confidence level, increased to 170 after adding a 10% non-response buffer.
analysis.main_results: The mean age of participants was 38.8 ± 7.4 years, with a male preponderance (60.7%). Only 18.9% had prior experience in diagnosing or managing Mpox, and 5.8% had good knowledge of Mpox, with a mean overall knowledge score of 61.7 ± 12.5%. Participants with ≥10 years of practice experience (p=0.049), senior professional cadres (p=0.031), and experience in diagnosing or managing Mpox (p=0.021) were associated with higher mean knowledge scores.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the notably low overall good knowledge rate as indicating a significant gap in participants' knowledge of Mpox. They highlighted that senior professional cadres, long years of practice, and experience in diagnosis and management were associated with higher yet suboptimal knowledge scores, underscoring the need for targeted educational interventions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeted educational interventions are needed to enhance primary care physicians' preparedness to identify and coordinate Mpox cases in primary care settings, which could improve surveillance, diagnosis, and patient management in North-Western Nigeria.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported knowledge scores limit causal inference and may introduce response bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size and the use of a convenience sampling method, which may affect generalisability to other regions or healthcare settings.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional online study assessed Mpox knowledge among 155 primary care physicians in North-Western Nigeria, revealing a notably low overall good knowledge rate of 5.8% and a mean knowledge score of 61.7%. Only 18.9% had prior experience managing Mpox, and higher knowledge scores were associated with senior professional cadres, longer practice experience, and prior Mpox management experience. papers.title_zh: 西北尼日利亚初级保健医师对猴痘知识水平的调查:一项在线横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Mpox is a rare but re-emerging zoonotic disease that causes significant morbidity and mortality. As primary care physicians serve as gatekeepers in the healthcare system, it is essential that they be proficient at identifying and coordinating care for suspected Mpox patients. However, there is a scarcity of studies on the knowledge of Mpox among primary care doctors in the northwestern geopolitical zone of Nigeria. Objectives This study assessed the knowledge of Mpox and its associated sociodemographic factors among primary care physicians in northwestern Nigeria. Methods This cross-sectional online study employed a multi-stage sampling technique to survey primary care physicians working in Family Medicine/General Outpatient and Pediatric Outpatient Clinics across hospitals in the seven states of North-Western Nigeria. The minimum sample size of 153 was calculated using an assumed 50% prevalence of good Mpox knowledge, a 5% margin of error, and a 95% confidence level; this was increased to 170 after adding a 10% non-response buffer. A total of 155 physicians completed the survey, giving a completion rate of 91.2%. Data were collected using a pretested, online questionnaire, and descriptive and inferential statistical analyses were done using Epi Info (version 7). Results The mean age of participants was 38.8 ± 7.4 years, with male preponderance (60.7%). Most were general outpatient clinic doctors (77.4%), with ≥ 10 years of practice experience (63.2%), and senior registrars (36.1%). Only 18.9% had prior experience in diagnosing or managing Mpox. Nine (5.8%) had good knowledge of Mpox, with a mean overall knowledge score of 61.7 ± 12.5%. Participants with ≥ 10 years of practice experience ( p = 0.049), senior professional cadres ( p = 0.031), and involvement in diagnosing or managing Mpox ( p = 0.021) were associated with higher mean knowledge scores. Conclusions The overall good knowledge rate was notably low, indicating a significant gap in participants’ knowledge of the various aspects of the disease. Senior professional cadres, long years of practice, and experience in the diagnosis and management of Mpox were associated with higher yet suboptimal knowledge scores. Hence, targeted educational interventions are needed to enhance their preparedness to identify and coordinate Mpox cases in primary care settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 猴痘 是一种罕见但重新出现的人畜共患疾病,可导致显着的发病率和 死亡率。由于初级保健医生充当医疗保健系统的看门人,因此他们必须精通识别和协调疑似 猴痘 患者的护理。然而,关于尼日利亚西北地缘政治区初级保健医生猴痘知识的研究却很少。目的 本研究评估了尼日利亚西北部初级保健医生对 猴痘 的了解及其相关的社会人口统计学因素。方法 这项横断面在线研究采用多阶段抽样技术对尼日利亚西北部七个州各医院的家庭医学/普通门诊和儿科门诊诊所工作的初级保健医生进行调查。最小样本量 153 是使用假设 50% 患病率 良好的 猴痘 知识、5% 的误差幅度和 95% 的置信水平计算得出的;添加 10% 无响应缓冲液后,该值增加至 170。共有 155 名医生完成了调查,完成率为 91.2%。使用预先测试的在线调查问卷收集数据,并使用 Epi Info(第 7 版)进行描述性和推论性统计分析。结果 参与者的平均年龄为 38.8 ± 7.4 岁,其中男性占多数(60.7%)。大部分为普通门诊医生(77.4%)、执业经验10年以上(63.2%)、高级挂号师(36.1%)。只有 18.9% 的人有诊断或治疗 猴痘 的经验。九人 (5.8%) 对 猴痘 有良好的了解,平均总体知识得分为 61.7 ± 12.5%。具有≥ 10年实践经验(p = 0.049)、高级专业干部(p = 0.031)以及参与诊断或处理猴痘(p = 0.021)的参与者与较高的平均知识得分相关。结论 总体良好知识率明显较低,表明参与者对该疾病各个方面的知识存在显着差距。高级专业干部、多年的实践经验以及诊断和猴痘管理经验与较高但次优的知识得分相关。因此,需要有针对性的教育干预措施,以增强他们在初级保健机构中识别和协调 猴痘 病例的准备。

papers.title: Evaluating search-enabled large language model interfaces for mpox public health consultation: a guideline-based comparative study
papers.abstract: Background Search-enabled large language model interfaces are increasingly used by the public for health information, but their performance in mpox-related public health consultation remains unclear. This study evaluated their safety, accuracy, empathy, reliability/information quality, and readability. Methods We conducted a single-query comparative cross-sectional evaluation using 52 predefined mpox-related public consultation questions. Each question was submitted once to each of six search-enabled LLM interfaces, yielding 312 first responses. Responses were assessed against a guideline-based reference framework. Safety was coded as a binary outcome, while accuracy and empathy were rated on 5-point scales. Reliability/information quality was evaluated using DISCERN, EQIP, JAMA benchmark criteria, and GQS. Readability was assessed using six established readability indices. Five trained raters independently evaluated the human-scored outcomes. Results Unsafe responses were relatively infrequent but occurred in all six interfaces, with safe-response rates ranging from 86.5 to 92.3%. No pairwise difference in Safety remained statistically significant after Benjamini–Hochberg correction. Overall differences across interfaces were statistically significant for Accuracy, Empathy, all four reliability/information quality measures, and all six readability indices. Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted post hoc analyses identified outcome-specific pairwise differences, although the pairwise patterns varied across measures. Conclusion The evaluated search-enabled LLM interfaces showed heterogeneous performance across safety, accuracy, empathy, reliability/information quality, and readability. Although unsafe responses were relatively uncommon, potentially harmful outputs occurred in every interface. analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the performance of six search-enabled large language model (LLM) interfaces in mpox-related public health consultation. The research aimed to assess safety, accuracy, empathy, reliability/information quality, and readability of responses to 52 predefined mpox-related questions. Each question was submitted to all six interfaces, resulting in 312 responses. The responses were evaluated using a guideline-based reference framework, with safety as a binary outcome, accuracy and empathy on 5-point scales, reliability/information quality using DISCERN, EQIP, JAMA benchmark criteria, and GQS, and readability using six established indices. The results showed that unsafe responses were relatively infrequent but occurred in all interfaces, with safe-response rates ranging from 86.5 to 92.3%. No pairwise difference in safety remained statistically significant after Benjamini–Hochberg correction. However, overall differences across interfaces were statistically significant for accuracy, empathy, reliability/information quality, and readability. The study highlights the need for guideline-based evaluation, source transparency, readability optimization, and safety safeguards for LLM interfaces used in mpox-related public health consultation. The findings are limited to a specific time and configuration snapshot and should not be generalized to base models or interpreted as establishing reproducible performance or a stable hierarchy across different settings.

elements_zh.methods: 根据基于指南的参考框架对反应进行评估。安全性被编码为二元结果,而准确性和同理心则按 5 分制进行评分。使用 DISCERN、EQIP、JAMA 基准标准和 GQS 评估可靠性/信息质量。使用六个既定的可读性指数来评估可读性。五名经过培训的评估员独立评估了人工评分的结果。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本杰明-霍赫伯格调整的事后分析确定了特定结果的成对差异,尽管成对模式因测量而异。经评估的支持搜索的 LLM 界面在安全性、准确性、同理心、可靠性/信息质量和可读性方面表现出异构性能。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在评估或考虑进行 猴痘 相关公共卫生咨询时,需要基于指南的评估、来源透明度、可读性优化和强大的安全保障措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 结果代表特定于时间和配置的接口级快照;它们不应被孤立地归因于底层基础模型,也不应被解释为跨会话、版本或设置建立可再现的性能或稳定的层次结构。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究评估了它们的安全性、准确性、同理心、可靠性/信息质量和可读性。我们使用 52 个预定义的 猴痘 相关公众咨询问题进行了单查询比较横断面评估。每个问题都向 6 个支持搜索的 LLM 界面中的每一个界面提交一次,产生 312 个第一响应。
analysis_zh.methods: 根据基于指南的参考框架对反应进行评估。安全性被编码为二元结果,而准确性和同理心则按 5 分制进行评分。使用 DISCERN、EQIP、JAMA 基准标准和 GQS 评估可靠性/信息质量。使用六个既定的可读性指数来评估可读性。五名经过培训的评估员独立评估了人工评分的结果。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本杰明-霍赫伯格调整的事后分析确定了特定结果的成对差异,尽管成对模式因测量而异。经评估的支持搜索的 LLM 界面在安全性、准确性、同理心、可靠性/信息质量和可读性方面表现出异构性能。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在评估或考虑进行 猴痘 相关公共卫生咨询时,需要基于指南的评估、来源透明度、可读性优化和强大的安全保障措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 结果代表特定于时间和配置的接口级快照;它们不应被孤立地归因于底层基础模型,也不应被解释为跨会话、版本或设置建立可再现的性能或稳定的层次结构。

Math. and Mech. 14(1) (2026) 108-121. https://doi.org/10.26541/ijaamm.2026.140110 Abstract A deterministic compartmental model is formulated for Mpox transmission dynamics in interacting human and rodent populations. The human population is divided into susceptible, exposed, infectious, quarantined, and recovered classes; the rodent population into susceptible, exposed, and infectious classes. A quarantined-to-susceptible pathway is incorporated to capture undetected cases re-entering the at-risk population. The basic reproduction number $R_{0}$ is derived using the next-generation matrix method. Local asymptotic stability of the disease-free equilibrium is established whenever $R_{0}<1$, and global asymptotic stability is proved using the Castillo-Chavez and Song approach. Routh-Hurwitz conditions are also derived for the endemic equilibrium. Normalised forward sensitivity analysis identifies the human-to-human rate and proportion of exposed humans to infected class as the dominant drivers of transmission; increasing recovery and treatment rates reduces $R_0$. Numerical simulations confirm that all infectious compartments decline asymptotically to zero when $R_{0}<1$, consistent with disease elimination. These results offer a quantitative basis for designing targeted Mpox control interventions, particularly through contact reduction and improved treatment coverage. Keywords Mpox; Deterministic model; Basic reproduction number; Disease-free equilibrium; Stability analysis; Sensitivity analysis; Next-generation matrix; Routh-Hurwitz criterion MSC (2020) 92D30; 34D20

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to analyze the transmission dynamics of Mpox virus through stability and sensitivity analysis to understand the factors influencing its spread and inform control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A deterministic compartmental model was formulated to study Mpox transmission dynamics in interacting human and rodent populations, with the human population divided into susceptible, exposed, infectious, quarantined, and recovered classes, and the rodent population into susceptible, exposed, and infectious classes.
analysis.methods: The study used a deterministic compartmental model, incorporating a quarantined-to-susceptible pathway to account for undetected cases. The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was calculated using the next-generation matrix method, and stability of equilibria was analyzed using Routh-Hurwitz conditions and Castillo-Chavez and Song approaches.
analysis.main_results: The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was derived, and it was found that the human-to-human transmission rate and the proportion of exposed humans entering the infectious class are the dominant drivers of transmission. Increasing recovery and treatment rates was shown to reduce $R_0$.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provide a quantitative understanding of the key factors driving Mpox transmission and highlight the importance of contact reduction and improved treatment coverage in controlling the disease.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results offer a foundation for designing targeted interventions to reduce Mpox transmission, particularly by focusing on contact tracing and enhancing treatment protocols.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a deterministic model, which may not fully capture real-world complexities such as stochasticity or variability in transmission rates. The evidence is strong for the model's stability analysis but limited in its applicability to real-world scenarios without further empirical validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a deterministic compartmental model to analyze the transmission dynamics of Mpox virus in human and rodent populations. The model incorporates a quarantined-to-susceptible pathway to account for undetected cases. The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was derived using the next-generation matrix method, and stability of equilibria was assessed. The results indicate that human-to-human transmission rate and proportion of exposed humans entering the infectious class are the main drivers of Mpox spread. Increasing recovery and treatment rates was found to reduce $R_0$. The findings suggest that targeted interventions, such as contact reduction and improved treatment coverage, could be effective in controlling the disease. However, the study's deterministic nature may limit its real-world applicability, and further empirical validation is needed to strengthen the evidence.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 制定了确定性区室模型来研究人类和啮齿动物群体相互作用中的 猴痘 传播 动态,其中人类群体分为易感、暴露、传染、隔离和康复类别,啮齿动物群体分为易感、暴露和传染类别。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用了确定性区室模型,结合了从隔离到易感的途径来解释未发现的病例。使用下一代矩阵方法计算基本再生数$R_0$,并使用Routh-Hurwitz条件和Castillo-Chavez和Song方法分析平衡稳定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 推导了基本传染数$R_0$,发现人传人传播率和暴露人群进入传染类别的比例是传播的主导驱动因素。提高回收率和 治疗 率可减少 $R_0$。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果提供了对驱动 猴痘 传播 的关键因素的定量理解,并强调了减少接触和提高 治疗 覆盖率在控制疾病方面的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果为设计有针对性的干预措施以减少 猴痘 传播 奠定了基础,特别是通过关注接触者追踪和增强 治疗 协议。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于确定性模型,该模型可能无法完全捕捉现实世界的复杂性,例如 传播 比率的随机性或变异性。该模型的稳定性分析证据充分,但在未经进一步实证验证的情况下,其对现实场景的适用性有限。

papers.title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
papers.abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:全球 暴发 猴痘风险需要高效的诊断工具。目前的方法速度缓慢,并且难以区分相似的皮肤病变,而深度学习模型缺乏多类分类的准确性和可解释性。本研究旨在开发一种高性能、实时筛查工具,用于早期检测猴痘和类似病症。方法:本研究提出了一种增强的架构,将高效通道注意力(HECA)机制纳入 YOLOv11 中,以改进特征选择。HECA 对输入特征图执行全局平均池化 (GAP) 和最大平均池化 (MAP)。该研究利用空间变换和像素域增强,建立并增强了包含猴痘、麻疹、水痘和正常皮肤图像的四类数据集。梯度加权类激活映射 (Grad-CAM) 生成用于病变定位可视化的热图,而基于 PyQt5 的交互式诊断界面则简化了临床工作流程。结果:实验结果表明,与测试集上的现有方法(EfficientNet-v2-l、GoogLeNet、ResNet50、VGG19、MobileNetv2、DenseNet201 和 YOLOv11s)相比,所提出的模型具有优越的性能,具有增强的检测速度、准确度(98.9%)、精确度(99%)、召回率(99.3%)和 F1 分数(99.1%)。在所有评估指标中,HECA-YOLOv11 的性能均优于 SE-YOLOv11 和 ECA-YOLOv11 超过 5.1%。热图分析证实了该模型对病变区域的关注,与医学推理相一致。讨论:集成的注意力机制和可解释性技术有效地解决了自动皮肤病变检测的关键限制。高性能和低延迟标志着可靠临床决策支持的重大进步,对早期 暴发 遏制具有重要意义。结论:HECA-YOLOv11框架为早期猴痘筛查提供了高度准确和高效的工具。其标准化界面在加速公共卫生应对和改善新发传染病的全球控制方面具有巨大潜力。

analysis.summary_en: This study explores mpox as a rare sexually transmitted dermatosis, emphasizing its clinical and epidemiological characteristics in this context. Conducted in a clinical setting, the research involved data collection from patients diagnosed with mpox in August 2026. The methods relied on clinical observation and patient data, leading to the identification of mpox as a sexually transmitted condition with distinct clinical features. The authors interpret these findings as highlighting the unique transmission dynamics and clinical presentation of mpox in sexual contexts, offering a novel perspective on its epidemiology. These results can inform targeted public health strategies for mpox surveillance and prevention. However, the study's observational design and limited sample size may affect the generalizability of the findings, though the evidence is considered strong due to direct clinical observations.

papers.full_text: Disclaimer: Early release articles are not considered as final versions. Any changes will be reflected in the online version in the month the article is officially released. Volume 32, Supplement –Summer 2026 SUPPLEMENT ISSUE Other Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023–May 2025 Cite This Article Citation for Media Abstract In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023–May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response. Since the first case was identified in a nonendemic region, mpox has emerged as an increasing public health concern in the United States. The global outbreak in 2022 affected 75 countries and territories; >2,300 cases had been confirmed in the United States by July 2022 (1). Because of evolving transmission dynamics, severity, and uncertainty surrounding social and economic impacts, the World Health Organization declared mpox a public health emergency of international concern on July 23, 2022 (2–3). Mpox is an infectious disease endemic to regions of Central and West Africa. It is caused by the enveloped DNA virus monkeypox virus (MPXV) and is characterized by fever, headache, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, and a vesiculopustular rash that can involve the face, extremities, and genital region (3). Mpox is primarily transmitted through direct contact with active lesions, contaminated materials, bodily fluids, or respiratory transmission at close range (4,5). Mpox infections are categorized into 2 genetically distinct clades, clade I and clade II. Clade II infections, which were responsible for the global outbreak that began in 2022, are generally associated with less severe disease and reduced transmissibility (5). Historically, clade I mpox infections have demonstrated greater virulence, mortality, and transmission (6). The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Wastewater Surveillance System initiated wastewater testing for MPXV in October 2022, five months after the mpox outbreak began in the United States. For underreported and stigmatized infections such as mpox, traditional case-based surveillance can present challenges, including incomplete capture of subclinical or unreported cases, making wastewater surveillance a valuable complementary approach to clinical mpox surveillance (5,6). Early work demonstrated that viral shedding through urine, feces, respiratory secretions, and skin lesions can result in detectable MPXV in wastewater, supporting wastewater-based epidemiology as a viable approach for monitoring and quantifying community transmission (2,7,8). In 1 study, MPXV detections in wastewater were shown to precede the identification of the clinical cases, highlighting its potential for early outbreak detection (9). Another study reported increases in wastewater viral concentrations ahead of reported clinical cases (5). Studies have also documented correlations between wastewater MPXV concentrations and incident mpox cases within corresponding sewersheds, supporting the utility of wastewater surveillance as a proxy for community-level transmission (10). Finally, wastewater detections in areas without corresponding clinical reports may help identify communities where mpox transmission might otherwise remain undetected because of social stigma, limited clinical recognition, or constrained diagnostic capacity (5,9). Recognizing wastewater surveillance as a valuable strategy for early identification of infectious disease activity, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (NCDHHS) integrated mpox monitoring into its statewide wastewater surveillance program. In September 2023, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at selected wastewater surveillance sites across the state. That assay detects orthopoxviruses including vaccinia, cowpox, and all clades of MPXV. Primary sites were facilities in Asheville, Charlotte, Greensboro, Greenville, and Raleigh; additional periodic testing was conducted at selected sites in Cary, Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham. To evaluate mpox wastewater surveillance program in North Carolina, we conducted this study to estimate sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) relative to confirmed clinical cases. Study Area and Surveillance Period We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance analysis to evaluate wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV circulation in North Carolina. For the period October 29, 2023–May 31, 2025, we compared wastewater detections from the North Carolina Wastewater Monitoring Network, operated by the NCDHHS, with confirmed clinical mpox cases using a +17-day temporal window. We assumed clinical case reporting to be complete for the purposes of this analysis. The study included data from 16 publicly owned wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) with defined catchment areas serving a combined population of 2,002,864 persons (Table 1). Facilities were in urban and semiurban regions and consisted of 4 plants in Charlotte, 3 plants each in Cary and Raleigh, and 1 plant each in Asheville, Chapel Hill, Greensboro, Greenville, North Durham, and South Durham. During the study period, 45 confirmed mpox cases occurred within the included sewersheds. We excluded sites sampled through CDC-contracted programs (Verily, https://verily.com) and WastewaterSCAN (https://www.wastewaterscan.org) because of differences in laboratory methods, assays, reporting structures, and sampling frequency. Clinical Case Data We also obtained clinical case data from NCDHHS. A confirmed mpox case was defined according to the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists case definition from 2022 (22-ID-10) as detection of nonvariola orthopoxvirus or MPXV DNA in a clinical specimen by PCR in a patient with compatible symptoms (11). We defined case date as date of symptom onset. We geocoded cases using residential address and spatially assigned them to sewersheds by using ArcGIS Pro (Esri, https://www.esri.com). Wastewater Sample Collection and Laboratory Testing. Influent wastewater was collected as 24-hour composite samples approximately 1 time/week at each WWTP except for the 3 plants in Cary and those in Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham, which were only sampled selectively over the study period, generally in response to concerns about a confirmed or suspected mpox case in the general area. Samples were transported on ice and processed within 24 hours at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. We quantified MPXV DNA using the CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test (12). We originally optimized the assay in a wastewater matrix by conducting a thermal gradient from 62°C–52°C to see which annealing temperature resulted in the greatest separation from positive and negative droplet clusters (Appendix Figure). We reported results as viral gene copies normalized to flow rate and population within the sewershed. We classified samples with concentrations above the assay limit of detection (LOD) as positive (n = 17). We experimentally determined the assay limit of blank (LOB) to be 0 copies/L by using methods adapted from Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute document EP17 (13). Because the LOB was 0, we theoretically estimated the assay LOD to be 500 copies/L, because Poisson distribution requires roughly 3 copies per sample to detect >1 copies with 95% probability (14,15). Using this strategy, we classified samples with concentrations from one half the LOD to the LOD as trace detections (n = 30). Overall Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, and NPV We classified wastewater observations as positive or negative on the basis of laboratory results, as described previously. For each wastewater sample, the presence of >1 confirmed clinical case within +17 days in the same sewershed was assessed. We selected a +17-day alignment window to approximate the biologically plausible period during which MPXV might be detectable in wastewater relative to a reported clinical case. Available data suggest that viral shedding is most likely to occur at 4 to 25 days (16,17) and might begin before diagnosis. Additional delays related to seeking care, laboratory confirmation, case reporting, and wastewater sampling can create temporal offsets between infection and detection. We selected the +17-day window to balance those biological and operational considerations while minimizing misclassification. We defined diagnostic categories as follows: true positive (TP), wastewater-positive and >1 clinical case within +17 days; false positive (FP), wastewater-positive and no clinical case within +17 days; true negative (TN), wastewater-negative and no clinical case within +17 days; and false negative (FN), wastewater-negative and >1 clinical case within +17 days. We calculated sensitivity (TP/[TP + FN]), specificity (TN/[TN + FP]), PPV (TP/[TP + FP]), and NPV (TN/[TN + FN]) overall and stratified results by WWTP/sewershed catchment. We calculated 95% CIs using Wilson score intervals because several sites had small denominators and proportions near 0 or 1. The primary analysis classified both positive and trace detections as wastewater-positive (n = 47). A secondary sensitivity analysis restricted wastewater-positive observations to samples exceeding the LOD (n = 17). Because clinical case surveillance is an imperfect reference standard and does not capture all infections, TP/FP/TN/FN classifications should be interpreted as concordance with reported cases rather than true infection status. All analyses were conducted in R version 4.2.3 (The R Project for Statistical Computing, https://www.r-project.org). During October 29, 2023–May 31, 2025, a total of 801 wastewater samples were collected across 16 WWTPs serving an estimated population of ≈2 million people. Of those, 47 (5.9%) were classified as wastewater-positive (17 above the LOD and 30 trace detections) and 754 (94.1%) were wastewater-negative. During the same period, 45 confirmed mpox cases were reported that fell within sewersheds representing the WWTPs in this study. Using a +17-day temporal alignment window, we classified 15 wastewater observations as TPs, 32 as FPs, 627 as TNs, and 127 as FNs (Table 2). The overall sensitivity of wastewater detection identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned reported mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%). Specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%). The PPV was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and the NPV was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). At the WWTP sewershed level, sensitivity was highest at Charlotte WWTP 2 (25.0%) and ranged from 0% to 25.0% across sites with clinical activity (Table 3). Several sewersheds had no temporally aligned clinical cases during the surveillance period, resulting in undefined sensitivity estimates. Specificity was consistently high across sites, ranging from 71.4% to 100%. PPV varied widely by facility, ranging from <1% to 100%, reflecting differences in case occurrence and sampling frequency. NPV exceeded 69% at all sites with clinical activity and was 100% at several facilities without aligned cases. When restricting wastewater-positive observations to samples exceeding the LOD (n = 17), sensitivity decreased from 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%) to 1.4% (95% CI 0.4%–5.0%), and specificity increased from 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%) to 97.7% (95% CI 96.3%–98.6%) (Table 2). The number of FP observations decreased from 32 to 15, whereas FN observations increased from 127 to 140. PPV decreased from 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%) to 11.8% (95% CI 3.3%–34.3%), and NPV was similar (83.2% vs. 82.1%). Site-level performance patterns were unchanged. This evaluation assessed the performance of wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV across 16 WWTPs in North Carolina during October 2023–May 2025. Using a +17-day alignment window, wastewater detection demonstrated low sensitivity for identifying temporally aligned clinical cases (10.6% overall when including trace detections and 1.4% when restricted to detections above the LOD) but high specificity (>95%) and moderate NPV of ≈83%. We selected a +17-day window to account for the expected duration of MPXV shedding and potential delays between symptom onset, clinical diagnosis, and case reporting, while also accommodating once-weekly wastewater sampling. Because wastewater represents a composite, time-integrated signal and samples are collected weekly, this window reduces misclassification that could arise from temporal offsets between individual infections and wastewater detection. Those findings compare with national estimates reported in another study (16) that observed a daily sensitivity of 13.8% for detecting >1 person shedding MPXV and a weekly sensitivity of 31.7%. The lower sensitivity observed in North Carolina likely reflects differences in analytic approach, case density, and assumptions about viral shedding. Adams et al. (16) assumed complete case ascertainment and uniform 25-day viral shedding after symptom onset of mpox, whereas our analysis relied on confirmed case onset dates and a fixed +17-day temporal alignment window. This approach likely provides a more conservative estimate of sensitivity because wastewater detections occurring outside the defined window were classified as discordant even if they reflected prolonged or presymptomatic shedding. In addition, only 45 cases were identified across a population of >2 million persons, limiting the probability that wastewater concentrations would exceed detection thresholds. Despite low sensitivity for detecting single cases, specificity was high (95%–98%), indicating that wastewater-negative observations were generally concordant with the absence of reported cases. The NPV exceeded 80% overall and was higher at several individual sites, suggesting that the absence of a wastewater detection was associated with a low likelihood of concurrent reported cases. However, the PPV was modest (31.9% in the primary analysis and 11.8% in the LOD-only analysis), reflecting that some wastewater detections occurred without temporally aligned reported cases. Such detections could represent travel-associated cases, delayed reporting, prolonged shedding, asymptomatic or subclinical infections, or infections among persons residing outside the mapped catchment area. As a consequence, wastewater detections occurring without temporally aligned reported cases should not necessarily be interpreted as analytical FPs and might indicate true but unrecognized infections, suggesting that PPV might be underestimated. Therefore, if even a subset of those observations represented true infections, the PPV of wastewater surveillance would be higher than estimated in this analysis. Of note, sensitivity increased substantially when trace detections were included, indicating that low-level signals contributed meaningfully to temporal concordance with reported cases. That finding underscores the tradeoff between sensitivity and specificity when defining wastewater-positive thresholds. Restricting classification to concentrations above the assay LOD generally increased specificity but markedly reduced sensitivity, potentially limiting early warning capacity in low-incidence settings. In North Carolina, trace detections are interpreted within a structured public health decision framework rather than as definitive evidence of transmission and might prompt notification of local health departments and wastewater partners, review of recent case activity, enhanced syndromic surveillance monitoring, and coordination regarding case investigation or specimen retesting. Those actions are consistent with our public health action decision tree for confirmed detections (Figure). Confirmed detections might also involve escalation actions such as broader public notification, targeted outreach, and intensified sampling. Several factors likely contributed to the low sensitivity observed. First, mpox incidence during the study period was low and sporadic, reducing the probability that viral shedding might be detectable within large, pooled wastewater catchments. Second, sampling occurred once per week, which might have missed transient shedding signals. Third, wastewater represents an aggregate population-level signal, and the dilution effect within large catchments (some serving >500,000 persons) might limit detection of individual infections. Fourth, alignment relied on residential address assignment; persons infected but not residing within the sewershed would reduce measured concordance. The first limitation of this study is that reported clinical cases are not a perfect standard for infection.
